# Contributing / 貢獻指南

- 中文：[docs/zh-TW/CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/zh-TW/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- English: [docs/en/CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/en/CONTRIBUTING.md)

送出前請去識別化：不要上傳 API key、OAuth 檔、真人照片或聲音、個人資料、本機路徑。
De-identify before you send: no API keys, OAuth files, photos or voices of real people, personal data or local paths.
